'''Echo Six''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Echo Flight]], a [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>

[[Harlaan]] served as Echo Six prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. He was shot down by [[Dren Melne]] during the [[Battle at TFP-9]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap" />
